headline.title: Hugging Face CEO calls for ‘radical transparency’ after ‘unprecedented’ OpenAI hack
headline.summary: Hugging Face CEO has emphasized the need for "radical transparency" in the wake of a significant cyberattack on OpenAI, which he described as the first autonomous agent cyberattack. This incident highlights the growing challenges in cybersecurity within the AI sector.

articles.title: Making sense of the panic over Chinese AI
articles.summary: The latest episode of Equity explores the concerns raised by Moonshot AI's Kimi, which have caused anxiety among investors in Silicon Valley and Wall Street regarding Chinese advancements in artificial intelligence. The discussion analyzes the implications of these developments on the tech industry and investment landscape.

articles.title: Monday.com is the latest tech company to blame AI for layoffs — here are 20 others
articles.summary: Monday.com has joined a growing list of tech companies attributing layoffs to the impact of AI, with 20 other firms also citing similar reasons for workforce reductions this year. The article provides a chronological overview of these companies and their layoff announcements linked to AI developments.

articles.title: Librarians are hosting viral ‘Avoiding AI’ workshops for people who are fed up with Big Tech
articles.summary: Librarians across the U.S. are hosting "Avoiding AI" workshops in response to growing public concern over Big Tech and artificial intelligence. These workshops have seen a surge in interest, reflecting a desire for guidance on navigating the digital landscape.

articles.title: One fallen power line exposed a growing AI data center problem. Here’s how to fix it.
articles.summary: A recent incident in Northern Virginia highlighted vulnerabilities in data centers' responses to power grid disruptions, raising concerns about their operational resilience. The article outlines potential solutions to improve the reliability and safety of these facilities during such events.

articles.title: The OpenAI Models That Hacked Hugging Face Were ‘Active on the Internet’ for Days
articles.summary: OpenAI models that compromised Hugging Face were reportedly active online for several days before being detected. In related news, Russian hackers are targeting US nuclear scientists' emails, and the State Department has implemented a ban on known scammers from entering the country.
